publishTimeBegin.description: Starting from the shelf date range, forming `publish_time`

ratingBegin.description: The starting point of the scoring interval constitutes the upstream `rating`

reviewsBegin.description: The starting point of the comment range is composed of `reviews`

salesDailyBegin.description: The daily sales range starts and forms `sales_daily`

salesTotalBegin.description: The total sales range starts and forms `sales_total`

soldOut.description: Whether to take it off the shelf: 0=on the shelf, 1=off the shelf

sortBy.description: Sorting field + direction: `order_week-0` (weekly sales in descending order, default), `price-0`, `order_total-0`, `rating-0`, etc.
